lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word, you ask me what I am.

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word, you ask me what I am.

lines: Tum hi kaho ke ye andaaz-e-guftagu kya hai?
couplets.en: Tell me yourself, what way is this to speak?

lines: Ragon mein daudte phirne ke hum nahin qayal
couplets.en: I put little faith in blood that merely runs through the veins.

lines: Jab aankh hi se na tapka to phir lahu kya hai?
couplets.en: If it never falls from the eye, what kind of blood is it?

lines: Daudte phirne ke hum nahin qayal
couplets.en: I put little faith in its coursing through the veins.

lines: Jab aankh hi se na tapka to phir lahu kya hai?
couplets.en: If it never falls from the eye, what kind of blood is it?

lines: Chipak raha hai badan par lahu se pairahan
couplets.en: Blood has made my shirt cling to my skin.

lines: Hamari jeb ko ab haajat-e-rafu kya hai?
couplets.en: What need is there now to mend my torn collar?

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e-guftaar aur agar ho bhi
couplets.en: My strength to speak is gone, and even if some remained, what then?

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e-guftaar aur agar ho bhi
couplets.en: My strength to speak is gone, and even if some remained, what then?

lines: To kis ummeed pe kahiye ke aarzoo kya hai?
couplets.en: With what hope could I say what I long for?
What is it I long for?

lines: Tum hi kaho ke ye andaaz-e-guftagu kya hai?
couplets.en: Tell me yourself, what way is this to speak?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho
couplets.en: At every word, you say the same thing.
